name: fl_prototype_harness
description: Throwaway logic and UI spike harness generator. Generates zero-dependency single-file HTML/JS interactive harnesses with in-memory state reducers, real-time state inspection panels, and floating variant switcher pills for rapid hypothesis testing without polluting production code.
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

action.description: Action to perform: 'scaffold_logic_spike' (default, generates state machine harness) or 'scaffold_ui_variants' (generates switcher pill harness).

title.description: Title and purpose of the prototype spike.

output_file.description: Path where the standalone HTML harness file should be saved.

state_fields_json.description: JSON object of initial state fields (e.g. '{"status":"idle","items":[]}').

actions_json.description: JSON array of action names to generate buttons for (e.g. '["START","PAUSE","RESET"]').

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear technical rationale explaining why this tool is called.
